verdict.rationale: Swell documents an official Swell CLI for creating and working with apps, themes and storefronts. It lists concrete commands (app init, app push, store switching), and its AI page says an installed agent picks up the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop; a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven CLI use, and documentation of agent-friendly specifics such as machine-readable output or non-interactive modes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Swell CLI is a command-line interface that helps you create and work with apps, themes, and storefronts.
swell app init: initialize an app in the current directory with a default config file and folder structure
swell app push: push configuration files to a development store
Install once and your agent picks up the file contract, the CLI and the validate-deploy-verify loop.
